summary: Unified Run Brief receipt (archive/$RUN/run-brief.json) emitted at finalize by 9 registry commands; render-run-brief.py renders chat/push text from it; /z-do is now a deprecated pass-through alias to /z-plan --quick and no longer independently participates.

entry_points.summary: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for archive/$RUN/run-brief.json; full vs lite profiles; embedded run_brief_registry $def.
Embedded registry schema mapping each v1 command to profile, init/finalize anchors, primary artifact, and fallbacks.
Subcommands: init, set-section (approach|outcome|next|status), append-decision, finalize; creates and validates run-brief.json.

Renders run-brief.json as warm Briefing markdown: glyph title, **What**/**How**/**Key decisions**/**Result**/**Next**; lite omits How+decisions. Accepts optional _cost_summary_text for appended cost block.
Single-line push digest: intent[:80] · outcome[:60] · Next: label. Also used as Discord body via notify-discord.sh.
Collects decision rows from events.jsonl (kinds: user_choice, user_override, plan_route_decision, next_step_choice); last wins per question_id.
Empty-only fallback: extracts up to 4 bullet/numbered lines from artifact; rejects lines with file.ext: tokens or slash segments.
Reads events.jsonl, produces cost summary Markdown text; passed via --cost-summary-text to render-run-brief.py; non-fatal if absent.
Posts Discord webhook embed (title + push-format body) from notify.discord_webhook_url config; 3s timeout, non-fatal.

Shared finalize fragment inlined via <!-- include: --> markers expanded by runtime/drivers/_export_utils.py; 6-step sequence (1 aggregate, 2 artifact/approach, 3 finalize, 3.5 cost, 4 chat, 5 push, 5.5 discord, 6 hard-gate); step 2 requires orchestrator to author approach before finalize on success.
Halt-path preamble for /z-execute; sets outcome + next then includes the shared finalize fragment. The only per-command halt-finalize fragment that actually exists on disk.

Schema + registry + renderer self-test + _test_finalize_preserves_decisions integration test (default mode). --registry-only greps 9 registry commands for finalize fragment include plus z-execute halt-fragment include; CURRENTLY FAILING on /z-do (deprecated alias, no longer self-finalizes).
/z-plan pre-subagent cost-gate terminal cleanup: set halted outcome/next, finalize, render with optional cost summary, require, then release claim before deregister.

invariants: Chat and push text are always rendered from run-brief.json — never independently authored at finalize.
render-run-brief.py --require runs before deregister on every terminal exit that includes the finalize fragment.
Empty decisions array is valid for full profile.
/z-stats is NOT auto-invoked at command end.
Lite profile omits approach and decisions keys entirely; chat renders What/Result/Next only.
Full-profile success: orchestrator MUST author approach via run-brief.sh set-section before finalize; extract_approach_bullets is the empty-only fallback.
intent max 240 chars, must not equal the command name alone; outcome max 400 chars.
Full profile approach: 1-4 bullets; no file paths (no ext: tokens or slash path segments).
Key decisions section is omitted from chat entirely when decisions is empty.
Decision tokens are humanized (underscores to spaces) in chat render; verbatim values remain in events.jsonl.
why field on decisions is surfaced in chat as italic text after an em-dash.
Cost summary (step 3.5) and Discord render (step 5.5) are non-fatal — failures do not block the hard gate or abort the run.
Full-profile complete path: even if artifact has no bullet lines, finalize preserves existing decisions and uses ensure_approach_for_full (not lite downgrade).
/z-plan pre-subagent cost-gate terminal paths reuse Run Brief halt-finalize semantics before claim release and active-plan deregister.
Cost summary injection in render-run-brief.py is optional and non-fatal; run-brief --require remains the hard validation gate before cleanup.

/z-do is a deprecated pass-through alias (routes to /z-plan --quick) and does not independently participate in the run-brief lifecycle; any brief tied to a /z-do invocation is actually /z-plan --quick's full-profile brief.
gotchas: Lite profile forbids approach and decisions properties — do not emit empty arrays.
Artifact missing on early halt triggers lite downgrade via finalize (not at init time) — but only on non-success paths; success with no artifact uses ensure_approach_for_full, not lite downgrade.
Export must inline _fragments/run-brief-finalize.md so Cursor/Codex/Antigravity copies stay in sync. Old scripts/export-*.py are deleted; use runtime/drivers/<target>/export.py or /z-export.
Z_HARNESS_RUN_BRIEF_DEBUG=1 optionally writes a human-readable run-brief.md mirror for local debugging (not default).
extract_approach_bullets only runs when approach is empty at finalize; an authored approach always wins.
Old ALL-CAPS labeled block format (INTENT:/APPROACH:/DECISIONS:/OUTCOME:/NEXT:) is obsolete — render_chat now emits glyph-titled Briefing markdown.
render_push format is UNCHANGED — single line: intent[:80] · outcome[:60] · Next: label. Discord step 5.5 uses the same push-format body via notify-discord.sh.
Decision source enum is event|artifact — no other values are schema-valid.

_test_finalize_preserves_decisions in lint-run-brief.sh proves that finalize keeps decisions[] intact when the artifact has no bullet lines on a complete path — guards against regression in the prose-only artifact code path.
/z-plan cost-gate cleanup happens after run-brief init/register; if register failed and no active-plan record exists, cleanup must not call deregister.

skills/z-plan/SKILL.md contains 10 occurrences of a bash comment `# include: _fragments/run-brief-halt-finalize-plan.md` referencing a fragment that has never existed. These sit inside fenced bash code blocks, so the real include-expansion mechanism (expand_includes in runtime/drivers/_export_utils.py, which skips markers inside fenced code) never processes them — they are inert documentation comments, not a functional dependency; the actual halt logic is inlined at each site instead.

/z-do (skills/z-do/SKILL.md) is now a deprecated pass-through alias that immediately routes to /z-plan --quick and stops; it never reaches its own run-brief finalize. The registry (docs/llm/run-brief-registry.json) still declares /z-do as lite profile, but that path is not exercised in current behavior — the only live entry into lite profile is run-brief.sh's automatic apply_lite_downgrade on a full-profile halt with no artifact.
